findings.evidence: Mathlib provides `Real.tanh_artanh {x} (hx : x ∈ Ioo (-1) 1) : tanh (artanh x) = x` (mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/SpecialFunctions/Artanh.lean:76); the file uses only `exp_artanh` (lines 71, 102) and exposes no `tanh` statement (grep `tanh` in EpsilonEridani hits only the `artanh` definition lines).
findings.fix: Add public `theorem tanh_rapidity (h : |⟪v.spatialPart, n⟫_ℝ| < v.timeComponent) : tanh (v.rapidity n) = ⟪v.spatialPart, n⟫_ℝ / v.timeComponent := by rw [rapidity_def]; exact Real.tanh_artanh (div_timeComponent_mem_Ioo h)` next to `rapidity_def`.
findings.issue: `rapidity` has no elimination lemma: the defining property `tanh (v.rapidity n) = ⟪v.spatialPart, n⟫_ℝ / v.timeComponent` (for `|⟪v.spatialPart, n⟫_ℝ| < v.timeComponent`) is absent, so any consumer needing the velocity–rapidity relation must `rw [rapidity_def]` and re-derive the `Ioo (-1) 1` membership.

findings.evidence: Lines 54–58: `private theorem div_timeComponent_mem_Ioo {v : Vector d} {a : ℝ} (h : |a| < v.timeComponent) : a / v.timeComponent ∈ Set.Ioo (-1) 1`, proved by `lt_div_iff₀`/`div_lt_iff₀` and `linarith` only; no Mathlib hit for an equivalent (`abs_div_lt_one` and variants: no matches).
findings.fix: Either state it on reals as a public lemma (`{a t : ℝ} (h : |a| < t) : a / t ∈ Set.Ioo (-1) 1`) in the Physlib-extensions file or a Mathlib-facing spot, or make it the public domain lemma for `rapidity` (`inner_div_timeComponent_mem_Ioo`) that `tanh_rapidity` and `exp_two_mul_rapidity` both consume.
findings.issue: `private div_timeComponent_mem_Ioo` is a pure real-number fact (`|a| < t → a / t ∈ Ioo (-1) 1`) dressed in a `Vector d` binder; its statement mentions only upstream types and its proof does not touch rapidity, so it is general infrastructure hidden as `private`.

findings.evidence: InvariantMass.lean:97 `have hsum : (q + P).spatialPart = q.spatialPart + P.spatialPart := by ext i; simp`; grep `spatialPart_add|timeComponent_add` across EpsilonEridani finds no such lemma, and MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean is the file this repo uses for exactly these Physlib extensions (lines 30–41).
findings.fix: If Physlib does not already provide it, add public `@[simp] lemma spatialPart_add (u v : Vector d) : (u + v).spatialPart = u.spatialPart + v.spatialPart` (and `timeComponent_add` if not already a simp lemma upstream) to `MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean`, and use it here; otherwise cite the upstream lemma instead of `ext i; simp`.
findings.issue: `(q + P).spatialPart = q.spatialPart + P.spatialPart` is proved inline (`ext i; simp`) inside the private helper `components_add_target`; it is a general additivity fact about Physlib's `spatialPart`, independent of the photon–target subject, and is unavailable to any other consumer.

summary: The new `Lorentz.Vector.rapidity` ships only the `_def` restatement and the exp/cosh/sinh consequences, but not its characteristic elimination `tanh (v.rapidity n) = v_∥ / v⁰`, so consumers must unfold and rebuild the light-cone domain proof that is itself hidden as a private helper. Additivity of `spatialPart` is proved inline inside a private Photoproduction helper instead of living publicly next to the other Physlib extensions.
